proofs.text: Run `--feature nosuch --quick` against a project holding only `feat`; verify exit 2 and `no spec named nosuch`. Run `--all --quick --project-root <a path that does not exist>`; verify exit 2 and `is not a directory`

reasons: PROOF-2 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: A `--feature` name with no spec under `specs/` exits 2 naming it, and a `--project-root` that is not a directory exits 2 saying so

tests.body:
def test_an_unknown_feature_exits_two(self, tmp_path):
        root = _project(tmp_path)
        _spec(root, 'feat')
        code, output = _run(root, '--feature', 'nosuch', '--quick')
        assert code == 2
        assert 'no spec named nosuch' in output
tests.name: test_a_missing_project_root_exits_two
